description: A payment stream's lump-sum value is the present value of each future payment at a discount rate you choose, and this tool computes it for level or yearly-increasing monthly, quarterly, semiannual or annual payments, such as structured settlement, annuity or seller-carried note payments, with an optional final lump sum. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

discount_rate.description: Discount rate you choose, annual % (monthly compounding).

first_payment_month.description: Months from today until the first payment. Default: one payment period.

lump_sum_month.description: Months from today until the lump sum (required with lump_sum).

payment.description: Amount of each payment, USD (the first year's amount if it increases).

name: payment_stream_value
title: Payment stream present value calculator
